requirement_text: General Entry Requirements (GER) for CAO/EU-EFTA-UK applicants, Leaving Certificate: standard route -- "Six Leaving Certificate subjects at Grade 06/H7 minimum", "English OR Irish" (one required), "Mathematics" required, "At least two subjects at grade H5." Exception route for applicants not meeting the standard requirement: six subjects at O6/H7 minimum plus "H4 in Irish, O4/H7 in English, and O4/H7 in Mathematics" and "At least three subjects at grade H5." DCU does not award CAO points for "Leaving Certificate Ordinary Alternative or Foundation level" Mathematics, but accepts it for admission to a specified list of ~15 programmes including Early Childhood Education, Communication Studies and Journalism.

limitations: No explicit cycle/entry year printed on this page; also note certain subject pairs (e.g. Physics/Chemistry combinations, Economics variants) are scored only once (highest grade counted) -- full list not transcribed.

requirement_text: English language proficiency requirements (general, applies to non-native speakers of English for undergraduate admission): "IELTS Academic: Composite score of 6.5 or above, with no less than 6.0 in any one component." "TOEFL iBT: Total Score of 92." "Cambridge Certificate: 180 on Cambridge English scale, with no less than 169 in each skill." "Pearson Test of English (PTE Academic): 63 with a minimum of 59 in all components." "Duolingo: a minimum overall score of 120 and a score of at least 110 in each of the Individual Subscores." "Scores on your English language proficiency test must be achieved in one sitting" and certificates must be obtained "within the two years prior to the start date of your DCU programme."
source_authority_note: dcu.ie is the official domain of Dublin City University, a public university established 1989; domain is .ie, not .edu/.ac./.gov.
limitations: No explicit cycle year printed; TOEFL computer-based (237) and paper-based (580) score equivalents also given on the page but these test formats are largely discontinued -- recorded the iBT figure as primary.

requirement_text: Non-EU IB Diploma requirement: minimum 24 points for most programmes, "At least 2 subjects at grade 5 higher level, 4 subjects at grade 4 standard level or above", must include Maths and English. Specific programmes set a higher minimum: example given, "DC002 Primary Teaching requires 35 points."

requirement_text: Non-EU application route: applicants "presenting non-Irish/non-EU qualifications should apply through the DCU student application portal" (dcuie2.elluciancrmrecruit.com/Apply), separate from CAO. Advanced Entry (transfer) applicants use the same portal with "a cover note indicating that you are applying for Advanced Entry" plus transcripts and syllabi. Applicants missing final English-test results may submit a "holding document" confirming the test name and expected result date, and may receive a conditional offer; five- or ten-week pre-sessional English programmes are available on campus for conditional-offer holders.

requirement_text: EU/EFTA/UK applicants "should apply for a place at DCU through the Central Applications Office (CAO)" including European Baccalaureate and IB awarded within Europe; qualifications are converted to Leaving Certificate point equivalents for competitive assessment. "Offers are made through CAO in late August/early September (Round 1)." All applicants to DCU must meet both "General Entry Requirements (GER) and Programme Entry Requirement (PER)."

requirement_text: 2026-27 tuition fee structure: "Student Contribution (All Students): €2,543 per annum." "All programme fees are per annum and subject to an annual increase." Representative EU vs non-EU fee bands by faculty: DCU Business School EU €5,922-6,250 / non-EU €17,000 flat across business programmes; Institute of Education EU €5,607-7,149 / non-EU €16,900; Faculty of Engineering & Computing EU €6,679-6,800 / non-EU €17,900-19,400; Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences EU €5,607-6,679 / non-EU €17,300 across most programmes; Faculty of Science & Health EU €6,250-8,415 / non-EU €15,900-23,000, with Nursing programmes at the top of that range (€23,000, DCU's highest non-EU undergraduate fee).
